headerTitle: Welcome to the latest version of La Ley

talks_books.title: Talks and Books
talks_books.description: More than 470 talks and books spanning Neville Goddard's body of work.

quotes.title: Quote Library
quotes.description: Nearly 1,000 built-in quotes distill the teachings of Neville, Joe Dispenza, Bruce Lipton, and Gregg Braden. You can also create your own personal quotes.

authors.title: Featured Authors
authors.description: Teachings from Joe Dispenza, Bruce Lipton, and Gregg Braden complement and broaden Neville's work with perspectives on neuroscience, epigenetics, and quantum creation.

encyclopedia.title: Encyclopedia
encyclopedia.description: A space to learn and discover ideas related to the teachings.

scientific_evidence.title: Scientific Research
scientific_evidence.description: A concise and growing collection of research and scientific studies related to these teachings.

notes.title: Unlimited Personal Notes
notes.description: Create notes by voice, share them, export them as QR codes, send them to Canvas, organize them into categories, and mark your favorites. AI tools include interpretation, practical application, and AI Chat.

journal.title: Personal Journal
journal.description: Record daily experiences and events to reflect on your assumptions, desires, and life through the lens of these teachings.

goals.title: Goals
goals.description: Create goals, track your progress, and access the information you need to pursue them effectively.

general_reminders.title: Reminders
general_reminders.description: Schedule alerts so nothing slips your mind. They are also useful for meditation, training, and other practices.

rituals.title: Morning and Evening Rituals
rituals.description: Structure your day with intention, stay present, and bring the day to a conscious and meaningful close.

mindful_presence.title: Mindful Presence
mindful_presence.description: Capture brief moments of awareness throughout the day and return to the present with one tap. Notice when you leave autopilot, recognize your mood, and reinforce the emotion of the future you want to live.

calm_space.title: Calm Space
calm_space.description: An immersive space to unwind and disconnect, designed to help ease stress and anxiety.

food_scanner.title: Food Label Scanner
food_scanner.description: Scan a barcode to get information about a food and practical tips for using it.

heart_brain.title: Heart–Brain Coherence
heart_brain.description: A guided assistant to help you enter a state of coherence between the heart and brain.

planner.title: Planner
planner.description: Organize tasks, events, and commitments over time so you can clear mental space, prioritize what matters, and use your time well.

knowledge_check.title: Knowledge Check
knowledge_check.description: A true-or-false game for reviewing and reinforcing what you have learned. Some questions are subtle and challenging.

qr.title: Built-in QR Sharing
qr.description: Import and export notes, quotes, and other information in the app's own QR format to share with friends and the community.

ai.title: Artificial Intelligence
ai.description: Interpretations, summaries, practical guidance, and chat about the teachings. It runs locally and responds within Neville's context.

canvas.title: Canvas
canvas.description: Design backgrounds with images, colors, and text—ideal for sharing quotes and thoughts with friends or on social media.

practice_reminders.title: Practice Reminders
practice_reminders.description: Schedule alerts for meditation, reading, prayer, gratitude, affirmations, shopping lists, and daily tasks.

open_journal.title: Open Journal
commands: Hey Siri, in La Ley, open journal
Hey Siri, in La Ley, open my journal

create_journal_entry.title: Create a Journal Entry
create_journal_entry.description: Create a journal entry in the background without opening the app.
commands: Hey Siri, in La Ley, create an entry
create_journal_entry.footer: Siri will ask for your password, a title, and the entry text. If the password is difficult to understand, spell it out slowly and clearly.

create_calm_phrase.title: Create a Phrase for Calm Space
create_calm_phrase.description: Create a personal phrase for Calm Space.
commands: Hey Siri, in La Ley, create a phrase for Calm Space
Hey Siri, in La Ley, create a personal phrase for Calm Space
create_calm_phrase.footer: Siri will ask you to dictate the phrase.

create_planner_item.title: Add an Item to the Planner
create_planner_item.description: Create a new item in the Planner.
commands: Hey Siri, in La Ley, add an item to the planner
Hey Siri, in La Ley, create a planner entry
create_planner_item.footer: Siri will ask you to dictate a title, date, and description.

open_notes.title: Open Notes
open_notes.description: Open the list of notes in the app.
commands: Hey Siri, in La Ley, open my notes

create_note.title: Create a Note
create_note.description: Create a note in the background without opening the app.
commands: Hey Siri, in La Ley, create a note
create_note.footer: Siri will ask you to dictate a title and the note text.

create_phrase.title: Create a Phrase
create_phrase.description: Create a personal phrase in the background without opening the app.
commands: Hey Siri, in La Ley, create a phrase
create_phrase.footer: Siri will ask you to dictate the new phrase.

random_talk.title: Open a Random Talk
random_talk.description: Open the app and display a talk chosen at random.
commands: Hey Siri, in La Ley, open a talk
